notes: One unadjusted NQ contract per session. New York overnight hours are 18:00–09:30 and regular hours are 09:30–16:00.
The study covers January 2015 through September 18, 2026. 2018–2019 supply 295 of 307 earlier-era sessions.
Reel benchmark: Instagram reel Dfai3hHvMDn by @rithvikrishna64. Its exact sample and event definitions are unavailable.
Reaches use one-minute OHLC. The study describes price behavior and does not estimate trade execution or returns.

sections.alt: First-boundary ordering and cumulative probability of reaching the near and far boundary.
sections.caption: First-boundary ordering and cumulative probability of reaching the near and far boundary.
sections.description: Keep same-minute order unresolved. Timing curves use all unique-near eligible sessions, with misses remaining in the denominator through the full horizon.
sections.finding: The near side went first on 73.1% of sessions and the far side on 22.3%. 0 sessions had unresolved order. By the first hour, the near side had been reached on 65.7% of all 1,820 sessions.
sections.title: Which boundary goes first, and how fast?

sections.alt: Adverse movement bounds before a near-side hit and full-session adverse movement on misses.
sections.caption: Adverse movement bounds before a near-side hit and full-session adverse movement on misses.
sections.description: Use the opening price as the reference. For hits, show a lower and upper bound because we cannot tell how much of the touch bar’s adverse extreme occurred before the touch.
sections.finding: On near-side hits, median adverse excursion was bounded by 14.5–16.5 NQ points. Sessions that missed the near side had a median full-session adverse excursion of 182.0 points (n=390).
sections.title: How far does price move away from the near side?

sections.description: Start the fresh-touch clock with the 09:31 minute. Remove sessions only when the specific boundary being measured was already reached in the opening minute.
sections.finding: The nearer level was reached in the opening minute on 337 sessions. Of the 1,483 still untouched at 09:31, 73.7% reached it later.
sections.title: What remains after the opening minute?
